decisions.decision: macOS Option 3 lock (JS-fallback bundle under Bun; no codesign / Apple Dev ID / Gatekeeper)
decisions.rationale: Picked by user 2026-06-09 during /gsd-progress; persisted in memory v1.3-macos-option-3.md

decisions.decision: Drop 2 darwin sibling packages entirely (no no-op shim)
decisions.rationale: Private @achilles npm scope means no squat risk; bin shim existsSync fallback handles missing-platform deterministically; 2 fewer packages to version-bump per release

decisions.decision: Full SKILL.md rewrite to terminal-only model (not one-line diff)
decisions.rationale: v1.2 SKILL.md described Electron + floating UI + askForMediaAccess + X-forwarding — all wrong under v1.3; leaving any of it in place lied to operators reading the manifest

decisions.decision: Single cleanup commit AFTER publish-success (not 2-stage; not CI-gated PR)
decisions.rationale: Simplest mental model; publish first, then cut; atomic rollback via git revert HEAD

decisions.decision: ERR-01 banner pre-empts ABOVE the status row (both rows visible during cascading failures)
decisions.rationale: User wants to see WHAT went wrong AND WHAT state they're in simultaneously; ARIA priority handles screen reader (banner=assertive, status row=polite)

decisions.decision: Siblings publish BEFORE parent in achilles-release.yml
decisions.rationale: Avoid the window where users running npm install -g achilles between parent-publish and sibling-publish would hit missing optionalDependencies (warnings, ugly UX)

decisions.decision: Rollback story is npm deprecate (not npm unpublish)
decisions.rationale: npm policy: unpublish only allowed within 72h AND no dependents; deprecate is always available and idempotent

decisions.decision: Workflow trigger is workflow_dispatch ONLY (no auto-push trigger)
decisions.rationale: User's global CLAUDE.md rule: never auto-run applications; operator must manually trigger releases
